defects.scope: All nonempty source-free validated PK1 and PK2 with neutral ability=0
defects.trace: Missing sourceProfile (or known conflicting-gen source normalized to empty) opens ability check; both native PK1/PK2 wrappers correctly expose ability 0; getAbilityNumberForId(0) returns 0 and isAbilityLegal returns false; unconditional Invalid is emitted despite native format having no abilities
native_negative_controls: Same PK1/PK2 records with matching red_gb/gold_gbc exact source should not emit ability Invalid
Native PK3/PK4 ability-mismatch controls must remain Invalid
unknown_source_controls: Same PK1/PK2 with conflicting Platinum/FireRed game labels must emit source mismatch Warning, not Ability Invalid
defects.coordinator_minimal_fix: Disable ability validation whenever verified native format is PK1 or PK2, regardless of sourceProfile presence; retain applicable modern/PK3/PK4 checks.

defects.scope: Source-free validated PK1 of a gendered species with neutral gender()=2
defects.trace: PK1 wrapper correctly returns gender=2 because no native gender exists. Missing sourceProfile enters gender check; per-species genderRatio !=255 makes neutral 2 appear as genderless and emits Invalid. Source label red_gb avoids check, so missing evidence paradoxically makes same bytes globally Invalid.
native_negative_controls: PK1 Bulbasaur with red_gb should not emit Gendered species marked genderless
PK1 Magnemite genderless ratio255 remains compatible
PK2 Bulbasaur native DV-derived gender must still be validated
defects.coordinator_minimal_fix: Skip gender-ratio checks for verified native PK1 irrespective of source label; preserve native PK2/PK3/PK4 gender checks.

standalone_execution.scope: Exact committed standalone C++ reproduces source conditions with synthetic native neutral fields; NOT full production Legality::analyze.

certainty: Two source-level counterexamples conclusively follow from exact adapter returns and integrated guard. Actual whole native analyzer repro intentionally not yet certified. No retail-original Pokémon historical authenticity or complete PKHeX parity claimed.
